TI.P: DECISION No 2/2019 OF THE JOINT COUNCIL
on the adoption of the Rules of Procedure for dispute avoidance and settlement and the Code of Conduct for arbitrators and mediators

GR.VISA.VISA: Having regard to the Economic Partnership Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the SADC EPA States, of the other part (the Agreement), and in particular Article 89(1) and Articles 100, 101 and 102 thereof,

ARTICLE.ALINEA: The Rules of Procedure for dispute avoidance and settlement, as set out in Annex I to this Decision, are hereby adopted.
The Code of Conduct for arbitrators and mediators, as set out in Annex II to this Decision, is hereby adopted.
This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its adoption.
